newsitem.title: FRANCE: French large retail stores have better 96 than 95.
newsitem.headline: French large retail stores have better 96 than 95.

text.p: Large retail store sales were better in 1996 than 1995 but only just on par with 1994, according to the national federation or large retail stores.
"1996 will be better than 1995, but we will only just be on par with 1994," Jacques Perrilliat, president of the federation, told Reuters.
"December will be above that of 1995, fortunately, but I think it will be a little below December 1994," he added.

The federation includes 163 large retail stores, 378 stores such as Prisunic and Monoprix as well as stores such as Virgin, FNAC, Marks & Spencers and C&A, with a total turnover of around 60 billion francs.
Member stores made about 25 percent of turnover in November and December, with the last month accounting for about 15 percent.
